Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a limited property tax exemption from the emergency medical services levy.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a limited property tax exemption from theemergency medical services levy; adding a new section to chapter 84.36RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All real and personal property is exempt from a county emergencymedical services property tax levy authorized under RCW 84.52.069 ifthe following requirements are met: (1) The property is located in a county with a population of morethan one million five hundred thousand; (2) The property is located in a city included within two counties;and (3) The locally assessed value of the property in the portion ofthe city included within the county described under subsection (1) ofthis section is less than one hundred twentyfive million dollars.
This act applies to taxes levied forcollection in 2012 and thereafter.
